mentions.name: Low Touch Advisor
mentions.description: This service connects early-stage startups with vetted senior and principal big-tech engineers for async Slack-based guidance, at $1,500/month with no long-term commitments, of which $1,000/month is paid to the providing engineer. It matches engineers to a team's needs so in-house engineers can do hands-on work, aiming to cut the risk of major rewrites on new projects. The source of supply is big-tech engineers who enjoy helping smaller startups and recently retired engineers.
mentions.problem: Startups lack affordable, equity-free access to senior and principal big-tech engineering guidance, which raises the likelihood of a major rewrite after months of effort on new projects.
mentions.audience: Early-stage startups that want affordable access to senior engineering guidance
mentions.source_excerpt: The name I'm using is Low Touch Advisor because we are selling what I call "low touch" help in the form of async Slack based guidance.
